name: Custom Dice
description: A six-sided die with rounded edges and flush inlaid faces in a second colour: standard pips (opposite faces add up to 7), numbers, your own words for an activity die (HOP, JUMP, SPIN, CLAP, SING, DANCE), or six picture shapes (heart, star, moon, sun, cloud, lightning). Prints without supports; up to six dice on one plate.
source: inspired by Printables Complete Giant Dice Set (16.7k downloads) and Customizable Dice
